# UI and UX Instructions

Apply these rules to `frontend\src\`.

## Rules

- Design for field phones and coordinator desktops.
- Make status, ETA, vehicle, identity, and update time easy to scan.
- Show loading, empty, stale, partial, unauthorized, and error states.
- Keep touch targets usable.
- Keep keyboard focus visible.
- Use semantic controls and accessible names.
- Do not rely on color alone.
- Keep auth logic in the existing clients.
- Do not use UI controls as server authorization.
- Use only synthetic data in screenshots.

Inspect visual changes at phone and desktop widths.
Capture before and after evidence when practical.
